'''Rednax''' was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]].

==Biography==
Rednax was known to frequent [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="SWArchive-Image Attack – Dug Model">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/09/imageattack20030909.html|series=Image Attack|text=Dug Model}}</ref> a diner in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district<ref name="DB-Jettster, Dexter">{{DB|character|dexterjettster|Jettster, Dexter}}</ref> on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name=":0" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[Gender/Legends|he]] and his pal [[Slyther Bushforb/Legends|Bushforb]] agreed to meet with [[Vekka Lodik]]'s boss, the holostar [[Seboca/Legends|Seboca]], at the Diner. The meeting went smooth save for Seboca's annoyance when the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] noticed a "[[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Poodoo/Legends|poodoo]],"<ref name="DBS">{{DB|character|slytherbushforb|Bushforb, Slyther}}</ref> actually [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], seated two booths behind.<ref name=":0">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==Equipment==
Rednax wore a dark [[Color/Legends|gray]] outfit.<ref name=":0" />

==Behind the scenes==
''[[Behind the Magic]]'' erroneously states that Rednax is the other Dug with the red leather jacket - [[Seboca/Legends|Seboca]].<ref name="Behind the Magic">{{InsiderCite|58|Behind the Magic}}</ref> Leland Chee and most other sources confirm that Rednax is the Dug in the dark gray outfit with the back of his spotted neck to the camera behind Obi-Wan.<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|holocron|29|Mistaken Identities}}</ref>
